description: Create a new construction defect tracking spreadsheet for warranty claims. Create 9 columns: Defect ID, Location, Category, Description, Date Noticed, Date Reported, Builder Response, Priority, Days Since Reported. Enter 6 defect records including basement water seepage, HVAC issues, door problems, plumbing leaks, paint issues, and electrical problems. Use formulas for 'Days Since Reported' column (=TODAY()-Date Reported). Format headers as bold with gray background. Color-code priorities (High=red, Medium=orange, Low=green). Add summary section with total defects, high priority count, and no response count. Save as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/warranty_defects.xlsx.
